mapper.select:
SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_num AS employeeNum, e.employee_name AS employeeName, f.file_url AS profileFileUrl, o.org_name AS orgName, p.position_name AS positionName, j.job_name AS jobName, r.rank_name AS rankName, e.employ_state AS employeeState, e.hire_date AS hireDate, h.employ_type AS employType, w.area_name AS areaName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = h.position_id LEFT JOIN hr_rank r ON r.rank_id = h.rank_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = h.job_id LEFT JOIN working_area w ON w.area_id = h.area_id LEFT JOIN hr_file f ON f.hr_file_id = e.profile_id
ORDER BY e.employee_name ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_num AS employeeNum, e.employee_name AS employeeName, f.file_url AS profileFileUrl, e.email AS email, e.phone AS phone, e.ext AS extensionNum, e.address AS address, e.birth_date AS birthDate, o.org_name AS orgName, p.position_name AS positionName, j.job_name AS jobName, r.rank_name AS rankName, e.employ_state AS employeeState, e.hire_date AS hireDate, h.employ_type AS employType, h.recruit_type AS recruitType, w.area_name AS areaName, e.bank_name AS bankName, e.resident_number_enc AS residentNumberEnc, e.account_number_enc AS accountNumberEnc FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = h.position_id LEFT JOIN hr_rank r ON r.rank_id = h.rank_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = h.job_id LEFT JOIN working_area w ON w.area_id = h.area_id LEFT JOIN hr_file f ON f.hr_file_id = e.profile_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT he.hr_event_id AS hrEventId, he.event_type AS eventType, he.event_title AS eventTitle, NULL AS requestedAt, NULL AS approvedAt, he.effective_from AS effectiveFrom, he.effective_to AS effectiveTo, he.reason AS reason, he.before_change AS beforeChange, he.after_change AS afterChange FROM hr_event he WHERE he.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY he.effective_from DESC, he.hr_event_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_sensitive_access_log ( viewer_employee_id, target_employee_id, field_type, access_reason, accessed_at ) VALUES ( #{viewerEmployeeId}, #{targetEmployeeId}, #{fieldType}, #{reason}, NOW() )
